name: Audience date
summary: A date answer on the audience phone: day, month and year fields in the order the question sets, with a numeric keypad, an ISO value and a respondent error for an impossible date.
highlights: Day, month, year in DMY, MDY or YMD order
Numeric keypad on a phone; browser autofill is off unless the host sets birthday
ISO YYYY-MM-DD value, empty until the date is real
Locks and restores the value after an iframe remount
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-audience-date> — for a date the participant types on the audience phone. It is three <aha-counted-input> fields with <aha-field-error variant="respondent"> under them, so it carries the same field look as every audience field; never a native date picker, which looks different on every phone and cannot take the deck colours. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Fields
spec.value: three Counted input fields at size large (48px, 16px / 24px text), no counter; day and month take 2 shares of the row, year 3

spec.label: Separator
spec.value: 16px / 24px, deck ink at 76%, 8px each side; hidden from assistive technology

spec.label: Typing
spec.value: digits only, 2 for day and month and 4 for year; a full day or month moves focus to the next field

spec.label: Error
spec.value: after leaving the group with a part-filled or impossible date: the fields take the error border and <aha-field-error variant="respondent"> shows the message 8px below, in the default ink

spec.label: Locked
spec.value: disabled or a locked lock-key: every field is disabled and the submitted date is restored

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: format
props.desc: The order of the day, month and year fields

props.name: value
props.desc: The date; '' until the three fields make a real date. Also the `value` property; `valid` is true when it is set

props.name: group-label
props.desc: The group's accessible name: pass the translated question

props.name: day-label / month-label / year-label
props.desc: Each field's accessible name; pass translated text

props.name: day-placeholder / month-placeholder / year-placeholder
props.desc: Each field's placeholder; pass translated text

props.name: error-message
props.desc: The respondent error shown after leaving the group with a part-filled or impossible date

props.name: birthday
props.desc: Opts the three fields into the browser's birthday autofill (bday-day, bday-month, bday-year); without it autocomplete is off, so a non-birthday date never offers the saved birthday

props.name: lock-key
props.desc: The submission-lock key for this question: once a submission is locked under it, the element locks and restores the submitted value, including after an iframe remount

props.name: change
props.desc: Fires on every keystroke with the ISO value ('' while not a real date) and whether it is valid

whenToUse.when: a date question on the audience phone or a survey respondent page: a birthday, a start date
a date in the product (editor, settings, reports)
a time of day or a date range

opinion.note: Replaces a native <input type="date"> or three hand-built inputs, which re-open the field look, the numeric keypad, the date check and the submission lock. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
